(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Member_PCP_Duplicates_in_PDS_2008_Stage_ODW_Member_PCP_Duplicates2760__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Member_PCP_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Member_PCP_Duplicates_in_PDS_2008_Stage_ODW_Member_PCP_Duplicates2760_') AS Member_PCP_Duplicates_in_PDS_2008_Stage_ODW_Member_PCP_Duplicates2760__sink_SchemaName,

SELECT 	SBSB.SBSB_ID + '00' SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR 	,MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT 	,'FAC' SRC_SYS_CD 	,'N' LOGICAL_DELETE_IND 	,'N' EDIT_ERROR_IND 	,MEPR.PRPR_ID PROVIDER_ID 	,MEPR.MEPR_MCTR_TRSN MBR_PCP_CHANGE_REASON_CD 	,MEPR.MEPR_TERM_DT MBR_PCP_END_DT 	,MEPR.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM CREATE_DTTM 	,NULL CREATE_USER_ID 	,MEPR.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM UPDATE_DTTM 	,NULL UPDATE_USER_ID     , getdate() as current_dt     , 'PDS_Load_Member_PCP_Staging' as create_user FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME  	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  		ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 	INNER JOIN ( 			SELECT MEME_CK,MAX(MEPR_EFF_DT) AS MAX_EFF_DT  			FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV  			WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN MEPR_EFF_DT AND MEPR_TERM_DT  				AND MEPR_PCP_TYPE = 'MP' 			GROUP BY MEME_CK 	) MAX_MEPR 		ON MAX_MEPR.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV MEPR  		ON MEPR.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 		AND MAX_MEPR.MAX_EFF_DT = MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT 		AND MEPR.MEPR_PCP_TYPE = 'MP' 		AND GETDATE() BETWEEN MEPR_EFF_DT AND MEPR_TERM_DT 	LEFT OUTER JOIN ##tmpPDSDuplicateMembers T ON T.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID 		AND SBSB.SBSB_CK <> T.SBSB_CK WHERE   T.SBSB_ID IS NULL

SELECT 	SBSB.SBSB_ID + '00' SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR 	,MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT MBR_PCP_BEGIN_DT 	,'FAC' SRC_SYS_CD 	,'N' LOGICAL_DELETE_IND 	,'N' EDIT_ERROR_IND 	,MEPR.PRPR_ID PROVIDER_ID 	,MEPR.MEPR_MCTR_TRSN MBR_PCP_CHANGE_REASON_CD 	,MEPR.MEPR_TERM_DT MBR_PCP_END_DT 	,MEPR.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM CREATE_DTTM 	,NULL CREATE_USER_ID 	,MEPR.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM UPDATE_DTTM 	,NULL UPDATE_USER_ID     , getdate() as current_dt     , 'PDS_Load_Member_PCP_Staging' as create_user 	, 0 AS Alerted_Ind FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME  	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  		ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 	INNER JOIN ( 			SELECT MEME_CK,MAX(MEPR_EFF_DT) AS MAX_EFF_DT  			FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV  			WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN MEPR_EFF_DT AND MEPR_TERM_DT  				AND MEPR_PCP_TYPE = 'MP' 			GROUP BY MEME_CK 	) MAX_MEPR 		ON MAX_MEPR.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV MEPR  		ON MEPR.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 		AND MAX_MEPR.MAX_EFF_DT = MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT 		AND MEPR.MEPR_PCP_TYPE = 'MP' 		AND GETDATE() BETWEEN MEPR_EFF_DT AND MEPR_TERM_DT 	INNER JOIN ( 		SELECT 			SBSB.SBSB_ID 			,MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT 			,COUNT(MEPR.PRPR_ID) AS RECORDCOUNT 		FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME  			INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  				ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 			INNER JOIN ( 					SELECT MEME_CK,MAX(MEPR_EFF_DT) AS MAX_EFF_DT  					FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV  					WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN MEPR_EFF_DT AND MEPR_TERM_DT  						AND MEPR_PCP_TYPE = 'MP' 					GROUP BY MEME_CK 			) MAX_MEPR 				ON MAX_MEPR.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 			INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV MEPR  				ON MEPR.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 				AND MAX_MEPR.MAX_EFF_DT = MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT 				AND MEPR.MEPR_PCP_TYPE = 'MP' 				AND GETDATE() BETWEEN MEPR_EFF_DT AND MEPR_TERM_DT 		GROUP BY SBSB.SBSB_ID 			,MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT 		HAVING COUNT(MEPR.PRPR_ID) > 1 	) SQL1 ON SQL1.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID ORDER BY SBSB.SBSB_ID + '00'
